name: Mending
overview: Scripture reveals that true mending originates from the Lord, who promises healing and restoration to those who obey His commandments and trust in His righteousness. God not only strengthens the physically weak and comforts the brokenhearted, but He also heals spiritual wounds through the sacrifice of Christ, whose stripes bring healing for our transgressions. A joyful and faithful heart is portrayed as life-giving medicine, contrasting with the destructive effects of a broken spirit, emphasizing that God’s sustaining presence and healing power address both body and soul.
